purpose: Reject duplicate JSON property names before RFC 8785/JCS canonicalization.

normative_reference.name: RFC 8785
normative_reference.requirement: JSON objects used as input data must not exhibit duplicate property names.

cases.reason: The same literal property name appears twice in one object.
An escaped property name decodes to the same string as another property name.
A nested object contains duplicate property names.
An object inside an array contains duplicate property names.
Escaped and unescaped solidus property names decode to the same string.
